3109d080d2613ed01f1459ac88244706dce591d1.summary: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 reports campaign CL-UNK-1211, observed from October 2025 to April 2026, targeting government entities and state-affiliated infrastructure on Linux servers. Attackers used web shells, a custom Go remote access trojan (SysGoRAT), open-source tools, credential harvesting, mailbox theft, database dumping and anti-forensics. The report says artifacts suggest AI-generated payloads. Whether the cluster is nation-state or cybercrime is not yet determined.
